name: Dixon Technologies

snapshot.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited manufactures and designs electronics including mobile and EMS, telecom, IT hardware, home appliances, lighting, and consumer electronics.

narrative: Management targeted strong IT hardware growth, successfully expanding revenues toward ₹1,500 crore as guided. Operating performance remains robust with positive revenue momentum across mobile and telecom segments, matching their strategic forecasts.

promises.statement: Targeting IT hardware revenues of almost INR 1,200 crores to INR 1,300 crores this year.

said.quote: So, this year, we are targeting revenues of almost INR 1,200 crores to Rs. 1,300 crores in this business

actual_source.quote: So this year, we feel the revenue should be in the range of INR1,500-odd crores

promises.note: IT hardware revenue reached ₹1,500 crore beating the INR 1,200-1,300 crores target.

promises.statement: Looking at a similar run rate of INR 2,000 crores for Q Tech.
